title: Fixed mixed campaign metadata in member history
summary: Architecture: repeated visits to one page share one history entry; the server reads the earliest available campaign. Problem: updating campaign fields separately can combine a new source with an older campaign. Solution: retain the first UTM-bearing visit as one complete snapshot, with absent fields empty. Capture it on a later visit only if the entry has no campaign yet.
validation: Proposed first-touch attribution fix. Retain same-path deduplication; test complete then partial campaigns and visits with no campaign.
